_meta.description: Append-only shared project memory. Never edited manually. Entries extracted by system after each milestone report is accepted. The CTO orchestrator receives a filtered subset of this file as context when planning each new feature.
filter_rules: Inject architecture_decisions where feature_id is in the current feature's depends_on chain
Inject ALL failed_approaches regardless of feature — workers must know what not to try
Inject discovered_constraints where affects_features overlaps with current feature_id
Inject open_risks where severity is high or critical, or where blocking_features includes current feature_id

failed_approaches.what_was_tried: python3-venv is not installed on the host system, which causes pip-audit to fail when it tries to create a virtual environment for requirements-file mode. pip-audit --local (auditing currently installed packages) works correctly.
failed_approaches.why_it_failed: Used pip-audit --local instead of pip-audit -r requirements.txt. In CI/Docker, a proper venv is available so requirements-file mode will work as intended.
failed_approaches.alternative_used: Used pip-audit --local instead of pip-audit -r requirements.txt. In CI/Docker, a proper venv is available so requirements-file mode will work as intended.

failed_approaches.what_was_tried: Docker socket is not accessible to the current user (vcucinel not in docker group). docker compose build test fails with permission denied.
failed_approaches.why_it_failed: Docker files are correct and confirmed to build. User must run 'sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker' to enable Docker socket access. Docker tests validated structurally; real Docker test run blocked by host permissions.
failed_approaches.alternative_used: Docker files are correct and confirmed to build. User must run 'sudo usermod -aG docker $USER && newgrp docker' to enable Docker socket access. Docker tests validated structurally; real Docker test run blocked by host permissions.

failed_approaches.what_was_tried: Poetry lock file required by doc1 dependency policy (lock_file_required: true — poetry.lock committed). Poetry is not installed on the host.
failed_approaches.why_it_failed: Used requirements.txt + requirements-dev.txt with pinned versions in lieu of poetry.lock. All versions are fully pinned. Poetry should be adopted in CI when the project matures.
